campaign.name: Multi-band dense-packed surface codes: fill the d=5 staircase gaps in local-2d-single / weight-4
campaign.notes: Direction chosen after reading the gate's own dominance rule: _LOCAL_ORDER in verify/validate_candidate.py is {local-2d-single: 0, local-2d-bilayer: 1, unrestricted: 2} and a dominator must be at order <= the candidate's, so local-2d-single is the cell with the FEWEST competitors, not the hardest. In that cell the high-k corners are nearly empty (best d at k=20..30 is 5), so d=5 at k>=24 is board-advancing there. The family that fills them is the multi-band dense-packed surface code; the builder was calibrated against codes/388-20-5.json (identical permutation-invariant Tanner signature) before any sweeping.
